messages:
sarah.ng: Mike (auditor) ping 3: we9re preparing SOC2 evidence for Nov 2025. Need a compact bundle: RBAC change history, PR approvals, CloudTrail extracts for role policy attach/detach, KMS rotation proof, key usage logs, and a short incident timeline if anything touched privileged roles.

mike_auditor: Thanks. Please scope to 2025-11-01 -> 2025-11-30. For KMS I need: rotation record (policy + date), key policy snapshot, and CloudTrail events showing Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey calls tied to the CMK. Also need SHA256 hashes and a manifest.csv mapping files -> control IDs.

devon.li: Understood. We9ll gather: infra ticket with approvals, PR link, CloudTrail filtered export, KMS key policy, KMS event export, and a short IR timeline if applicable. Any preferred control IDs naming?

mike_auditor: Use our standard SOC2 mapping: AC-1, AC-6 for access management, CMK-1 for key management, IR-2 for incident response. Just note mapping in the manifest.

alejandro.moreno: I queried CloudTrail for AttachRolePolicy/DetachRolePolicy events across Nov 2025. Command I ran: 

```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events \
  --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=AttachRolePolicy \
  --start-time 2025-11-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-11-30T23:59:59Z \
  --query 'Events[].{Time:EventTime,User:Username,Event:EventName,Resources:Resources}' \
  > /tmp/cloudtrail_privileged_2025-11.json
```

alejandro.moreno: Uploaded scoped export to evidence bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/eng-security/audit-2025-11/cloudtrail_privileged_2025-11.json

sarah.ng: Can you also include the infra ticket and PR approvals? We need the approval chain (who requested, who approved, who executed).

devon.li: Ticket: INFRA-1122 (privileged-role-update). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4570. Approvals: /lgtm from @platform-owners, security sign-off in ticket INFRA-1122. Execution performed by SSO session: users/svc-ci@redwood with assumed-role arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/AdminRole/svc-ci-session.

mike_auditor: Good. For KMS details please provide: key alias, rotation date and policy, key policy snapshot, and the CloudTrail events for kms.amazonaws.com for Nov. Also where the CMK is used (EBS, S3, EKS secrets, RDS).

alejandro.moreno: CMK alias: alias/redwood-prod-main-cmk. Rotation occurred 2025-10-29 (auto-rotate enabled annually). Rotation report PDF: s3://redwood-evidence/kms/rotation/rotation_report_2025-10-29.pdf. Key policy snapshot: s3://redwood-evidence/kms/policies/alias_redwood-prod-main-cmk_policy_2025-10-29.json

alejandro.moreno: KMS CloudTrail extract command I used:

```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com \
  --start-time 2025-11-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-11-30T23:59:59Z \
  --query 'Events[].{Time:EventTime,User:Username,EventName:EventName,CloudTrailEvent:CloudTrailEvent}' \
  > /tmp/kms_events_2025-11.json
```

alejandro.moreno: Uploaded kms_events_2025-11.json to s3://redwood-evidence/eng-security/audit-2025-11/kms_events_2025-11.json

sarah.ng: For evidence that data keys are encrypted with the CMK: I pulled snapshots showing S3 bucket encryption config and EBS volume attachment metadata. Paths: s3://redwood-evidence/encryption/s3_bucket_encryption_snapshot_2025-11-05.json and s3://redwood-evidence/encryption/ebs_encryption_snapshot_2025-11-18.json

mike_auditor: Also provide the KMS usage matrix showing which services reference alias/redwood-prod-main-cmk during Nov.

alejandro.moreno: I have a quick CSV: s3://redwood-evidence/kms/usage/kms_usage_matrix_2025-11.csv (columns: resource,type,operation,timestamp).

sarah.ng: On the incident/vuln side: we had a scan alert during a canary deploy on 2025-11-12. CVE-2025-4321 flagged in our build image. Triage indicated it was a transient build toolchain mismatch. Ticket: INFRA-1199. We rebuilt images with pinned dependency and redeployed. IR ticket for the permission blip during same deploy: IR-2025-51 (permissions misapplied to CI role) 3: misconfig lasted ~24 minutes and was rolled back. Logs and timeline are in s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/IR-2025-51/

devon.li: I exported deploy logs and the vuln scan snapshot: s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/IR-2025-51/deploy-log-2025-11-12.txt and s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/IR-2025-51/scan-snapshot-2025-11-12.png. Also added the remediation PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4582 and vuln ticket INFRA-1199.

mike_auditor: OK. For final delivery: we require manifest.csv with columns: filename,sha256,control_id,timestamp,uploader. Also prefer S3 presigned links (1 week TTL) to each artifact.

sarah.ng: I9ll generate SHA256s and the manifest. Plan: collect all files, compute hashes in a clean build host, upload manifest.csv + sha256s to s3://redwood-evidence/manifests/manifest_nov_2025.csv and post presigned links here. ETA 90 minutes.

alejandro.moreno: One more ask: retention proof for CloudTrail. Our CloudTrail bucket lifecycle is 7 years; encryption SSE-KMS with alias/redwood-logs-cmk. Retention policy doc: s3://redwood-evidence/retention/cloudtrail_retention_policy_2024-03.pdf

mike_auditor: That9s sufficient for initial review. If we need deeper session-level traces (per-API key or session tags) I will request specifics. Please include in the manifest a mapping to AC-6/CMK-1/IR-2 and ensure the ticket and PR links are resolvable.

sarah.ng: Will do. Posting presigned links once manifest and hashes are uploaded. Thanks team. :thumbsup: 

mike_auditor: Thanks, looking forward to the bundle.
